quicraft.settings.title: QUICraft
quicraft.settings.transport.auto.tooltip: QUIC when the server offers it, TCP otherwise. If QUIC doesn't work, you join over TCP without noticing.
quicraft.settings.transport.tcp-only.too: Always TCP, exactly like the game without QUICraft.
quicraft.settings.transport.quic-only.to: QUIC without falling back to TCP. Joining fails with QUIC's error if QUIC doesn't work. For testing servers.
quicraft.settings.forget_failures.toolti: Servers where QUIC failed are skipped for a while (up to an hour). Use this after fixing a firewall to try QUIC again right away.
quicraft.settings.native.available: QUIC is available on this computer.
quicraft.settings.native.unavailable: QUIC is not available on this computer (no QUIC library for this system). You always connect over TCP.
